title: Hercules Powerbuilding Program
author: Fin
desc: Basic program to build strength and muscle without needing fancy gyms or equipment. Rep schemes change weekly to push a range of adaptations and breaks the monotony 5x5 style programs. Not percentage based so enables the lifter to train as hard as possible based on their strength and energy on every given workout without the fear of “missing” reps commonly found it aggressive percentage based programs.

ex.note: Not meant to be max height. Each rep should be maximal effort to a moderate height box. Goal is to land as softly on the box while also reducing the amount knees need to be lifted to make the jump.
Number of reps is per leg. Can be done stationary 1 leg at a time or alternating.
Lower weight slowly and under control on each rep and squeeze at the top of the rep for 1-2 sec. Focus on the strain on the muscles over the adding of weight. Chase the pump and burn on these.
